subject: Unit economics deep-dive: $/feature, CAC payback & token pricing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam@fintechx.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Unit economics deep-dive: initial ask and next steps

Hi Sam — great follow-up from today’s demo, thanks for the time. Quick recap + asks so we can pull together an accurate cost model for FintechX: 

1) Target launch scope: which features from the demo are highest priority (e.g., invoice auto-extract, conversational assistant, fraud scoring)?
2) Expected monthly active users (MAU) and expected prompts per MAU in month 1 / steady-state. 
3) Average tokens per prompt (rough range fine: 50-150 / 150-400 / >400).
4) Target unit economics: do you have an internal target $/1M tokens or $/feature you need us to hit? You mentioned wanting a sub-$10k/month inference cost for the initial pilot — can you confirm gross budget range for the next 12 months?

Attached is our latest pricing sheet (Redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.pdf) and a simple token estimate template (FintechX_token_estimate.xlsx) — if you can fill basic volumes we’ll run a unit-econ model (inference cost, expected margin, CAC payback).

Next steps I propose: you send back the filled worksheet, we run 2 pricing scenarios (hosted vs dedicated reserved), then a brief call with our Solutions Engineer to align technical assumptions. Any objections?

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Redwood Inference — production-first inference runtime

From: Sam Patel <sam@fintechx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@fintechx.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T09:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Unit economics deep-dive: initial ask and next steps

Marissa — thanks, appreciate the clear asks. Quick answers to get you started: 

- Priority features for pilot: conversational assistant (customer support triage) and invoice parsing for enterprise customers. We will gate fraud scoring for later phases.
- Expected MAU: 15k in month 1, ramp to 150k by month 12.
- Prompts per MAU per day (steady state): 1.2 avg/day (support use case) — assume 36 prompts/month per MAU.
- Average tokens per prompt: ~300 tokens (prompt+response avg)
- Budget: For pilot we have ~$25k/month inference budget and hope to see ~$50k/month by month 6. 
- Target economics: our FP&A lead wants to see $/1M tokens and $/feature sensitivity; ideally we need to keep incremental inference cost per customer (per-month) under $2.50 to hit target margins.

I filled the token_estimate worksheet with the rough volumes — attached. Happy to hop on a short follow-up after you run the scenarios.

Thanks,
Sam
Head of Product, FintechX
sam@fintechx.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-02T11:18:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: quick unit-econ sketch for FintechX (do not forward)

Marissa/Rishi — Sam sent the volumes. My quick back-of-envelope:

Assumptions pulled from our pricing sheet (hosted gen):
- Hosted inference list price: $3.50 / 1M tokens (generation-heavy models).
- Dedicated (reserved) effective cost: $1.10 / 1M tokens (at 6-12 month commit, depends on model/quantization).

FintechX volumes (steady-state month 12):
- MAU: 150k, prompts/month per MAU: 36 => total prompts = 5.4M prompts/month.
- Avg tokens/prompt 300 => 1.62B tokens/month => 1620 * 1M tokens/month.

Monthly inference cost (hosted list): 1620 * $3.50 = ~$5,670 / month? (Note: check arithmetic)

Hold on — I clearly messed up arithmetic here, re-calc below to avoid mistakes before we give numbers to Sam. Rishi: can you sanity-check?

I’ll run a formal sheet with 3 scenarios: pilot (15k MAU), steady-state hosted, steady-state dedicated. Include per-customer monthly inference and CAC payback (use their stated CAC target? ask for CAC if they have one).

Regards,
Stephanie
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam@fintechx.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-04T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unit economics deep-dive: initial ask and next steps

Sam — thanks for the sheet and the clear budget callouts. We ran the scenarios (summary below) and flagged a few follow-ups so our model aligns with your FP&A goals. Full spreadsheet and MAP link are attached.

Summary (high level)
- Pilot (15k MAU, 36 prompts/mo, 300 tokens): ~162M tokens/mo => ~162 * 1M tokens. Hosted cost (list): 162 * $3.50 = $567 / month (this looks wrong in our early note — we corrected arithmetic in the attached sheet). Dedicated reserved (estimate): 162 * $1.10 = $178.2 / month.

- Steady state (150k MAU): 1.62B tokens/mo => 1620 * 1M tokens. Hosted list: 1620 * $3.50 = $5,670 / month. Dedicated: 1620 * $1.10 = $1,782 / month.

Notes on arithmetic and units: we realized initial unit mismatch in a quick chat — the two scenarios above reflect 1M-token units correctly (attached sheet shows line-by-line math). The key takeaway: per-1M token price swings materially by deployment mode (hosted vs reserved) — roughly ~3x in list-to-dedicated in our assumptions.

Per-customer per-month inference (steady state)
- Tokens per MAU per month: 36 * 300 = 10,800 tokens => 0.0108 * 1M tokens. 
- Hosted cost per customer/month: 0.0108 * $3.50 = ~$0.0378 (~$0.04) 
- Dedicated cost per customer/month: 0.0108 * $1.10 = ~$0.0119 (~$0.01)

CAC payback implications
- If your target incremental inference cost per customer is <$2.50/month, you’re well below that on both hosted and dedicated under these token assumptions (nice). That leaves room for GTM spend/CAC before margins compress. We’ll add sensitivity: higher token avg (400–600) and higher prompts/day.

Next steps
1) Confirm the pilot MAU and whether tokens per prompt estimate (300) should be treated as conservative or optimistic.
2) Intro to our Solutions Engineer for a 30-minute tech alignment (I’ll include performance/caching assumptions that can reduce per-token cost further).
3) We’ll send a formal Mutual Action Plan that includes pricing scenarios (hosted list, 6/12-month reserved, and hybrid burst) and example ROI/CAC-payback tables.

If these calculations look reasonable I’ll schedule the SE call for early next week and attach the finalized spreadsheet + MAP link.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.pdf, FintechX_token_estimate.xlsx
